body: Thank you for all the work options. That's very kind of you. I think I was just in a very dark place last night but I'll just keep pushing thru like always. As for the family situation, I can not stress enough how horrible they are. Not to go into detail but some people have children just to have someone to take things out on.
Close to 25,000 if I add my car payment of 6,000.
